note: Karayol et al. (2024) characterized 25 individuals harboring both missense and protein-truncating MSL2 variants, observing coordination problems and seizures across the combined cohort.

evidence.text: In a cohort of 25 individuals with heterozygous missense or protein-truncating variants in MSL2, patients exhibited core neurodevelopmental phenotypes including motor coordination issues and seizures.

source.title: MSL2 variants lead to a neurodevelopmental syndrome with lack of coordination, epilepsy, specific dysmorphisms, and a distinct episignature
source.quote: Here we describe 25 individuals with heterozygous, missense, or protein-truncating variant alleles in MSL2, delineating genotypes and phenotypes associated these variants with … MSL2 variants were associated with NDD phenotypes including global developmental delay, intellectual disability, hypotonia, and motor issues such as coordination problems, feeding difficulties, and gait disturbance.

evidence.text: Karayol-Borroto-Haghshenas syndrome manifests with variable severity where more than one-third of individuals develop epilepsy alongside motor and neurodevelopmental features.
